title: Life & Annuities
meta_description: Life books run on decades-long promises: underwriting quality at issue, servicing responsiveness across 30-year relationships, and actuarial integrity a.

blocks.x: Life & Annuities: the operating units, priority programs and the five capability towers that matter most here.

The workflows we industrialize here: Underwriting evidence assembly, Policy servicing transactions, Claims/beneficiary processing, Actuarial valuation data prep, In-force retention actions. Each arrives with its current cycle times measured in the Diagnose phase, and each leaves the program governed by outcome SLOs rather than anecdotes.

items: APS records, paramedical data and financial underwriting arrive as documents; assembly consumes days per case.
Valuation and experience studies assemble from extracts with manual reconciliation; regime changes (IFRS 17) expose the debt.
Surrender, loan and beneficiary transactions route through document-heavy queues with abandonment risk.
Underwriting health data and beneficiary PII create long-retention sensitive estates; PQ exposure deep.
Policy admin systems resist product change; new products take quarters.
Lapse and mortality experience signals arrive late; retention and repricing actions lag.

blocks.x: How we help — five priority capabilities

items: Goal-directed agents that run inside your systems with defined roles, budgets and human checkpoints. Every action is logged, measurable and reversible.
Valuation and experience pipelines with lineage for IFRS 17 — regime-change readiness without panic
Classification-aware controls for health/PII archives: sensitive estate governed
Strangler decomposition of policy admin wrappers: product change lead time halved
Payment and engagement signals predicting lapse with action policy — retention actions timely

blocks.x: We staff a named pod for this sub-industry pattern: delivery lead, quality owner and control owner, with the follow-the-sun rhythm covering build, run and the conformance monitoring that keeps the design honest after handover.
